special_abilities.name: Fiery Nature
special_abilities.desc: Is infused with elemental power and it requires only half the amount of air food and drink that a typical Monstrosity of its size needs.

special_abilities.name: Glide
special_abilities.desc: Has membranes between its fore and hind limbs that expand while falling to slow its rate of descent to 60' per round landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 ft. horizontally for every 1' it falls. Can’t gain height with its gliding membranes alone. If subject to a strong wind or lift of any kind can use updraft to glide farther.

special_abilities.name: Glow
special_abilities.desc: Sheds dim light in a 10 ft. radius.

special_abilities.name: Heated Body
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the ember glider or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 4 (1d8) fire.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

tob3_equitox.name: Equitox
tob3_equitox.senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 30 ft., passive Perception 16
tob3_equitox.damage_resistances: cold, fire, lightning; nonmagic B/P/S attacks

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: With items it has up to 60' to unoccupied space it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Withering Gaze
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
Locks eyes with one creature within 60' that can see it. Target: DC 18 Wis or stunned by thirst until end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Gore
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
Makes one Gore attack.

special_abilities.name: Befouling Aura
special_abilities.desc: At each of its turns' start all within 30': disadvantage on next attack/ability check as moisture within it is diseased (DC 18 Con negates). If creature spends 1+ min in equitox’s aura or drinks water within aura: contract gullylung fever disease (below; DC 18 Con negates). Creatures immune to poisoned are immune to this.

special_abilities.name: Gullylung Fever
special_abilities.desc: Creature infected with this disease manifests symptoms 1d4 days after infection: difficulty breathing dehydration and water-themed nightmares. Until cured at end of each long rest infected creature must make DC 18 Con save or its Str score is reduced by 1d4. Reduction lasts until creature finishes long rest after disease is cured. If disease reduces creature’s Str to 0 creature dies. A creature that succeeds on two saves recovers from the disease.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Arm Spine Regrowth
special_abilities.desc: The erina has twenty-four arm spines that it can use to make Throw Spine attacks. Used spines regrow when it finishes a long rest.

special_abilities.name: Expert Wrestler
special_abilities.desc: The erina can grapple creatures two sizes larger than itself and can move at its full speed when dragging a creature it has grappled. If it grapples a Small or smaller creature target has disadvantage on its escape attempts. Erina has advantage on ability checks and saves made to escape a grapple or end restrained condition.

special_abilities.name: Hardy
special_abilities.desc: The erina has advantage on saves vs. poison.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Spines
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches erina or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage. A creature grappled by or grappling erina takes 5 (2d4) piercing damage at start of the erina’s turn.

special_abilities.name: Bickering Heads
special_abilities.desc: A kobold ettin’s constant bickering can be easily heard and proves a tough habit to disrupt. It has disadvantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to stay silent but it has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks. Has advantage vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious.

special_abilities.name: Might of Giants
special_abilities.desc: Though squat by ettin standards kobold ettins are as much giant as they are kobold. It is a Large Giant for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

tob3_faux-garou.name: Faux-Garou
tob3_faux-garou.languages: understands creator's languages but can't speak
tob3_faux-garou.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Transforms into Large or smaller Beast matching type of lycanthrope it resembles (wolf if it resembles a werewolf etc.) or back into its true form. Its stats other than size and speed are same in each form. While transformed retains constructed appearance and claws at end of its forelimbs. Items worn or carried not transformed. Reverts to true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Druidic Vengeance
special_abilities.desc: Knows scent and appearance of each creature it was created to kill. Advantage on attacks vs. such creatures and on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find and track them.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Necrotic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals extra 3d6 necrotic (included below).

tob3_forgotten-regent.name: Forgotten Regent
tob3_forgotten-regent.languages: any languages it knew in life
tob3_forgotten-regent.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lighting, thunder; nonmagic B/P/S attacks not made w/silvered weapons
tob3_forgotten-regent.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

legendary_actions.name: Army of the Damned
legendary_actions.desc: Raises an arm into the air sending out a chill wind that empowers Undead allies. Each friendly Undead within 30' of it gains 10 temp hp.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
Magically teleports along with any items worn or carried up to 120' to an unoccupied spot it sees.

legendary_actions.name: Frozen Rune Maul
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
Makes one Frozen Rune Maul attack.

special_abilities.name: Frozen Citizenry (1/Day)
special_abilities.desc: Magically calls 2d4 skeletons or zombies (regent’s choice) or two glacial corruptors (see Tome of Beasts 2). Called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds acting as allies of the regent and obeying its spoken commands. The Undead remain for 1 hr until regent dies or until regent dismisses them as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Frozen Reign
special_abilities.desc: When a friendly Undead within 30' of regent hits with any weapon weapon deals an extra 4 (1d8) cold.

special_abilities.name: Glacier Imprisonment (Recharge 6)
special_abilities.desc: One creature regent can see within 60' of it: DC 16 Con save. If save fails by 5+ creature is instantly petrified in magical ice block. Otherwise creature that fails save begins to freeze and is restrained. Restrained creature must re-save at end of its next turn becoming petrified in magical ice block on a failure or ending effect on a success. Petrification lasts until creature is freed by greater restoration spell or other magic. Or the ice block can be attacked and destroyed (AC 15; hp 30; vulnerability to fire; immunity to poison and psychic) freeing the creature. When ice block takes damage that isn’t fire petrified creature takes half the damage dealt to the ice block.

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: Move through others/objects as difficult terrain. Takes 5 (1d10) force if it ends turn in object.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: Choose to succeed failed save.

special_abilities.name: Turning
special_abilities.desc: [+]Defiance[/+] It and any Undead within 30' of it: advantage on saves vs. turn undead.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

tob3_frostjack.name: Frostjack
tob3_frostjack.damage_resistances: B/P/S damage from nonmagical attacks not made w/cold iron weapons

reactions.name: Hoarfrost Warding
reactions.desc:
3/día.
When it takes fire it gains resistance to fire including triggering attack until end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Chilling Presence
special_abilities.desc: At the start of each of its turns each creature within 15 ft. of it: 5 (2d4) cold (DC 16 Con negates). For each min a creature spends within 15 ft. of it: suffer one level of exhaustion from cold exposure (DC 16 Con negates). Unprotected nonmagical flames within 15 ft. of it are extinguished. Any spells of 3rd level or lower that provide resistance to cold and that are within 15 ft. of it immediately end. Water freezes if it remains within 15 ft. of it for at least 1 min.

special_abilities.name: Ice Walk
special_abilities.desc: Move across and climb icy surfaces with o ability check. Difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra move.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

tob3_fungi-duskwilt.name: Fungi, Duskwilt
tob3_fungi-duskwilt.languages: understands Common and Undercommon but can't speak, telepathy 120' (with other fungi only)

special_abilities.name: Light Absorption
special_abilities.desc: Light within 60' of the duskwilt is reduced. Bright light in the area becomes dim light and dim light in the area becomes darkness.

bonus_actions.name: Expose Stalk
bonus_actions.desc: Exposes central stalk above ground until end of its next turn or until it ends effect as bonus action. If exposed can't burrow.

bonus_actions.name: Rapid Burrow
bonus_actions.desc: Burrows up to 60 feet. Opportunity attacks vs. it are made with disadvantage when mulcher burrows out of an enemy's reach this way. Creatures grappled by it are freed before it burrows.

reactions.name: Emergent Stalk
reactions.desc: When reduced below half hp max or creature scores critical hit vs. it immediately uses Expose Stalk.

special_abilities.name: Central Stalk Weakness
special_abilities.desc: When exposed central stalk can be attacked and destroyed (AC 13; hp 50; vulnerability to acid cold and fire). If central stalk is destroyed mulcher has disadvantage on attacks and can’t use Expose Stalk until it regrows one at end of next long rest.

special_abilities.name: Disturbed Soil (Exposed Stalk Only)
special_abilities.desc: Ground within 20' is difficult.

special_abilities.name: Mulcher Pit
special_abilities.desc: If it burrows 20'+ straight toward a creature can dig 10 ft. diameter 20' deep pit beneath it. Each Large or smaller creature in pit’s area: fall into mycelium-lined pit and land prone taking 14 (4d6) piercing damage from spiked mycelium + fall damage (DC 15 Dex doesn't fall). Can make one Mycelium Spike vs. prone creature in pit as bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Stalk Regeneration (Exposed Stalk Only)
special_abilities.desc: Gains 15 hp at start of its turn if it has at least 1 hp.

tob3_fungi-mush-marcher.name: Fungi, Mush Marcher
tob3_fungi-mush-marcher.languages: understands Common, + one language known by its grower, but can't speak

bonus_actions.name: Recall Harpoon
bonus_actions.desc: Pulls on the mycelial threads connecting it to its harpoon returning the harpoon to its empty hand. If harpoon is stuck in a creature that creature must make DC 13 Str save or be pulled up to 15 ft. toward marcher.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on hearing Wis (Perception) checks.

special_abilities.name: Partial Echolocation
special_abilities.desc: Its blindsight is reduced to 10 ft. while deafened.

tob3_fungi-void-fungus.name: Fungi, Void Fungus
tob3_fungi-void-fungus.languages: understands Common and Void Speech but can't speak, telepathy 60'
tob3_fungi-void-fungus.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from patch of glowing fungus.

special_abilities.name: Illumination
special_abilities.desc: Sheds dim light in a 10 ft. radius.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: Multiple Heads
special_abilities.desc: Has three heads. While it has more than one head it has advantage on saves vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious. Whenever it takes 25 or more damage in a single turn one head dies. If all its heads die it dies. At the end of its turn it grows two heads for each head that died since its last turn unless it has taken fire since its last turn. Regains 10 hp for each head regrown in this way.

special_abilities.name: Trampling Charge
special_abilities.desc: If it moves 20'+ straight toward creature and then hits it with Bite on same turn target must make a DC 16 Str save or be knocked prone. If target is prone garmvvolf can make one Bite vs. it as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Wakeful
special_abilities.desc: While it sleeps at least one of its heads is awake.

tob3_gearmass.name: Gearmass
tob3_gearmass.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

special_abilities.name: Amorphous
special_abilities.desc: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Clanging Mass
special_abilities.desc: Is filled with metal objects that clang scrape and clink together as it moves. When it moves it has disadvantage on Dex (Stealth) checks to stay silent until start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Ooze Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require sleep.

special_abilities.name: Rust Metal
special_abilities.desc: Any nonmagic metal weapon that hits gearmass corrodes. After dealing damage weapon: permanent cumulative –1 penalty to damage. If penalty drops to –5 destroyed. Nonmagic metal ammo that hits gearmass destroyed after dealing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Ghostly Mount
bonus_actions.desc: Can summon or dismiss a ghostly mount mounting or dismounting it as part of this bonus action with o spending movement. Mount uses the stats of a warhorse skeleton except it has the Incorporeal Movement trait a flying speed of 60 feet 40 hp and resistance to cold and necrotic and B/P/S damage from nonmagical attacks. If mount is slain it disappears leaving behind no physical form and templar must wait 1 hr before summoning it again.

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If mounted and it moves 20'+ straight to foe and hits with shadow blade on same turn target takes an extra 10 (3d6) slashing damage.

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: Move through others/objects as difficult terrain. Takes 5 (1d10) force if it ends turn in object.

special_abilities.name: Turning Defiance
special_abilities.desc: It and all ghouls within 30' of it: advantage on saves vs. turn undead.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

bonus_actions.name: Leaping Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Leaps up to 15 ft. with o provoking opportunity attacks.

special_abilities.name: Blood Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint by scent the location of creatures that have blood within 60' of it.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: Its long jump is up to 30' and its high jump is up to 15 feet with or with o a running start.

tob3_giant-flea-swarm.name: Giant Flea Swarm
tob3_giant-flea-swarm.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

special_abilities.name: Blood Sense
special_abilities.desc: The giant flea can pinpoint by scent the location of creatures that have blood within 60' of it.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Ravenous
special_abilities.desc: When a creature that doesn’t have all of its hp starts its turn in the swarm’s space that creature must make DC 12 Dex save or lose 5 (2d4) hp from blood loss.

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The swarm’s long jump is up to 30' and its high jump is up to 15 feet with or with o a running start.

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny flea. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temp hp.

reactions.name: Runic Shield
reactions.desc: Adds 4 to its AC vs. one attack that would hit it as green runes encircle the giant. To do so giant must see the attacker and can't be invisible

special_abilities.name: Death Malison
special_abilities.desc: When it dies the runes on its body flash a bright green then turn to mundane malachite. Each creature within 20' of giant: cursed 7 days (DC 16 Con negates) or until lifted by remove curse spell or similar. While cursed creature has disadvantage on saves and on first attack roll it makes on each of its turns. Fiends have disadvantage on the save.

special_abilities.name: Rune-Powered Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon weapon deals extra 2d8 fire (included in below).

special_abilities.name: Stone Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

special_abilities.name: Hypnotic Luminescence
special_abilities.desc: Tendril on giant’s head sheds bright light in 60' radius and dim light extra 60'. When creature that can see the light starts its turn within 60' of giant creature charmed 24 hrs (DC 18 Cha negates) regarding giant as friendly acquaintance. If giant or one of its allies harms charmed creature this effect ends. If save succeeds/effect ends for it creature immune to giant's Hypnotic Luminescence for next 24 hrs. At start of its turn lantern giant chooses whether this light is active.

special_abilities.name: Limited Amphibiousness
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe air and water but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hrs to avoid suffocating.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Aquatic Creatures
special_abilities.desc: Communicate with Monstrosities and Beasts that have a swim speed as if they shared a language.

bonus_actions.name: Water Jet
bonus_actions.desc: Each creature within 5 ft. of shrimp is blinded until start of its next turn (DC 14 Dex negates). The shrimp then swims up to half its swimming speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

special_abilities.name: Fluorescing Challenge
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks while agitated as its fluorescence flashes in a disorienting array.

tob3_giant-mole-lizard.name: Giant Mole Lizard
tob3_giant-mole-lizard.senses: blindsight 10 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 9

bonus_actions.name: Mass Shove
bonus_actions.desc: Each Large or smaller creature within 10 ft. of the giant mole lizard and that isn't grappled by it must make DC 14 Str save or be pushed up to 15 ft. away from the lizard and knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Beast of Burden
special_abilities.desc: Is considered to be a Huge Beast for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

bonus_actions.name: Burst of Speed
bonus_actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
Takes the Dash action.

bonus_actions.name: Puff Up
bonus_actions.desc: For 1 min it increases in size by filling its stomach with air or water. While puffed up it is Medium doubles its damage dice on Bite and Spine attacks (included above) and makes Str checks and Str saves with advantage. If pufferfish lacks the room to become Medium it attains the max size possible in space available.

special_abilities.name: Spiny Body
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches pufferfish or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 2 (1d4) piercing damage. While it is puffed up this damage increases to 5 (2d4).

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe only underwater.

bonus_actions.name: Harness Dwarven Soul
bonus_actions.desc: Draws on the soul fragment trapped in one of the dwarven skulls on its belt. Armorer has advantage on ability checks when using smith's tools and on attack rolls using a battleaxe handaxe light hammer or warhammer until start of its next turn. It carries six skulls on its belt.

special_abilities.name: Forged Forgery
special_abilities.desc: Thursir armorers wear armor forged from dwarven armor and shaped to resemble dwarven armor. Skilled blacksmiths can recognize and exploit this design quirk. When a creature proficient with smith’s tools scores a critical hit vs. thursir armorer armorer’s armor breaks reducing armorer’s AC by 5 until armorer repairs armor. If armorer is critically hit by any creature while its armor is broken armor shatters and is destroyed reducing armorer’s AC to 12.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Protect the Hearth
special_abilities.desc: When she is hit by a weapon attack up to two friendly creatures within 60' of her that can see her can use their reactions to move up to their speed toward priestess.

bonus_actions.name: Startling Display
bonus_actions.desc: Each creature within 5 ft. of the stick: DC 13 Int save or be incapacitated until end of its next turn. The walking stick then flies up to its flying speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from normal forest vegetation. Ex: small tree large branch.

special_abilities.name: Forest Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

special_abilities.name: Trampling Charge
special_abilities.desc: If it moves 20'+ straight toward a creature and then hits it with Ram attack on same turn target: DC 13 Str save or be knocked prone. If target is prone stick can make one Spine attack vs. it as a bonus action.

tob3_gigantura.name: Gigantura
tob3_gigantura.languages: understands Aquan and Deep Speech, but can't speak

special_abilities.name: Telescoping Eyes
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on sight and magical darkness doesn’t impede its darkvision. Also disadvantage on ability checks and saves vs. being blinded.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe only underwater.

tob3_glacial-crawler.name: Glacial Crawler
tob3_glacial-crawler.senses: blindsight 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 18

special_abilities.name: Acidic Coating
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the crawler or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 9 (2d8) acid.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Snow Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

special_abilities.name: Tunneler
special_abilities.desc: Can burrow through ice snow and permafrost and leaves a 5 ft. diameter tunnel in its wake.

bonus_actions.name: Snow Step
bonus_actions.desc: Teleports with items worn/carried up to 30' to unoccupied space it can see. Origin and destination must have snow.

special_abilities.name: Aura of Hope
special_abilities.desc: Surrounded by aura of courage. Each friendly creature within 30' of it: advantage on saves vs. being frightened.

special_abilities.name: Glorious Milk
special_abilities.desc: Can spend 1 min slowly drinking from a bowl of melted ice water. When it stops bowl is filled with pale milk. A creature that drinks the milk regains 7 (2d6) hp and its exhaustion level is reduced by up to two levels. After gnyan’s milk has restored a total of 20 hp or reduced a total of four exhaustion levels in creatures gnyan can’t create milk in this way again until it finishes a long rest.

special_abilities.name: Pounce
special_abilities.desc: If it moves 20'+ straight to creature and hits it with Claw attack on same turn target knocked prone (DC 13 Str not prone). If target is prone gnyan can make one Bite vs. it as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Snow Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: Dex (Stealth) to hide in snowy terrain.

special_abilities.name: Snow Strider
special_abilities.desc: Can move across icy surfaces with o an ability check and difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement. It leaves no tracks or other traces of its passage when moving through snowy terrain.

tob3_goblin-siege-engine.name: Goblin Siege Engine
tob3_goblin-siege-engine.languages: understands creator's languages but can't speak
tob3_goblin-siege-engine.damage_immunities: poison, psychic; nonmagic bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks not made with adamantine weapons
tob3_goblin-siege-engine.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

special_abilities.name: Adaptable Locomotion
special_abilities.desc: Moving through difficult terrain doesn’t cost it extra movement. In addition it has advantage on ability checks and saves made to escape a grapple or end the restrained condition.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Defensive Mount
special_abilities.desc: Can serve as a mount for one Large creature up to 4 Med creatures or up to 6 Small or smaller creatures. While mounted creatures riding in siege engine’s turret gain half cover.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: Immune: form-altering spells/effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Siege Monster
special_abilities.desc: Double damage to objects/structures.

tob3_godslayer.name: Godslayer
tob3_godslayer.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone

bonus_actions.name: Hunting Step
bonus_actions.desc: Magically teleports with items worn/carried up to 120' to unoccupied space within 15 ft. of a Celestial Fiend divine avatar or deity it senses with Divine Sense magically shifting from Material to Ethereal or Shadow Planes or vice versa. Godslayer has advantage on next attack roll it makes vs. target before start of its next turn. Glowing glyphs appear at origin and destination when it uses this.

reactions.name: Parry Spell
reactions.desc: If it succeeds on a save vs. spell of up to 8th level that targets only godslayer spell has no effect. If godslayer succeeds on the save by 5+ spell is reflected back at spellcaster using slot level spell save DC attack bonus and spellcasting ability of caster.

legendary_actions.name: Arcane Word
legendary_actions.desc: One Lexicon glyph on target within 90' it can see.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Makes one Energy Glaive or Rune Discus attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Up to its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

special_abilities.name: Arcane Lexicon
special_abilities.desc: Glyphs on its body cast ghostly copies into the air forming into eldritch incantations. It chooses up to 3 creatures it can see within 90' of it choosing one of the following options for each. A creature can’t be targeted by more than one effect at a time and godslayer can’t use same option on more than one target.Death Glyph Target marked for death until start of godslayer’s next turn (DC 25 Wis negates). While marked target takes extra 11 (2d10) force each time godslayer hits target with Energy Glaive.Glyph of Despair Target overwhelmed with despair for 1 min (DC 25 Cha negates). While overwhelmed with despair target has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.Glyph of Pain Target overwhelmed by pain incapacitated until its next turn end (DC 25 Con negates). No effect: Undead/Constructs.Glyph of Summoning Target magically teleported to an unoccupied space within 15 ft. of godslayer (DC 25 Wis negates).Retributive Glyph Target marked with retributive glyph until the end of its next turn (DC 25 Dex negates). While marked creature takes 9 (2d8) force each time it hits a creature with weapon attack.Stupefying Glyph Target blinded and deafened until the end of its next turn (DC 25 Con negates).

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Divine Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint the location of Celestials Fiends divine avatars and deities within 120' of it and can sense general direction of them within 1 mile of it. This extends into Ethereal and Shadow Planes.

special_abilities.name: Divine Slayer
